id="S:1"><div class="content-body"><h2 class="heading">De la Fuente oversees 41st consecutive unbeaten match</h2><p>Spain head coach Luis de la Fuente expressed pride after seeing his side extend their extraordinary unbeaten run to 41 matches across all competitions. <em>La Roja</em> recorded a 3-1 UEFA Nations League Group 3 victory against Czechia at the Estadio Carlos Tartiere.</p><p>Goals from Lamine Yamal, Rodri, and Mikel Merino kept Spain top of Group 3 with nine points.</p><p>De la Fuente utilized deep squad rotation throughout the international break.</p><h2 class="heading">Manager prioritizes player welfare amidst heavy fixture list</h2><figure class="content-figure"><div class="content-image"><img alt="Manager prioritizes player welfare amidst heavy fixture list" fetchPriority="high" loading="eager" width="960" height="540" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="standard-img" style="color:transparent" src="https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/b7151e2a7ed1be73f0ef277bd007319bf5129ea418e07d32acf93ad51055cb30/lightyear_networkapi/resizefill_w960%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Fgoal_uk_815%2F787641bf5406210b60cff740312d9f0d.jpg"/></div><figcaption class="fig-caption"><div style="max-height:none;overflow:visible"><span class="[&_p]:inline"><p>Manager prioritizes player welfare amidst heavy fixture list</p></span></div></figcaption></figure><p><a data-ylk="slk:Speaking after the final whistle;elm:context_link;itc:0;sec:content-canvas;" data-yga="{"yLinkText":"Speaking after the final whistle","yLinkElement":"context_link","yModuleName":"content-canvas","yHasCommerce":false}" href="https://www.uefa.com/uefanationsleague/match/2047971--spain-vs-czechia/" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow">Speaking after the final whistle</a>, De la Fuente admitted that second-half substitutions disrupted Spain's attacking rhythm, allowing Czechia to score. However, he insisted that protecting players from fatigue and injury remains essential.</p><p>The coach revealed that no single player was asked to complete 270 minutes across the window.</p><p>"First half, we were dominant, creating chances. I don't think our attitudes changed in the second half, but we made changes and the tempo altered," De la Fuente said. "We lost a bit of sharpness, but we think a lot about how to keep our footballers well. None of my players has played three complete matches in this international window."</p><h2 class="heading">Head coach values suffering in victory</h2><p>De la Fuente noted that enduring difficult periods during matches serves as valuable preparation for major tournament knockout fixtures. He praised his squad for holding firm under Czech pressure.</p><p>Spain maintain a three-point lead over England at the top of Group 3.</p><p>"I always say that any slip, any drop in attention can cost you goals and matches – so I'm extra proud that we continue with our unbeaten run," De la Fuente added. "We suffered tonight, and I'd say that we're not so used to that."</p><h2 class="heading">Spain prepare for upcoming away test in Croatia</h2><figure class="content-figure"><div class="content-image"><img alt="Spain prepare for upcoming away test in Croatia" fetchPriority="high" loading="eager" width="960" height="540" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="standard-img" style="color:transparent" src="https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/3b2b59657564dfc1e15babf16698c131f3e81711de6dc2064272a5f3d33e720a/lightyear_networkapi/resizefill_w960%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Fgoal_uk_815%2Fc18a9e54f171bb75bc4d04e7b7010632.jpg"/></div><figcaption class="fig-caption"><div style="max-height:none;overflow:visible"><span class="[&_p]:inline"><p>Spain prepare for upcoming away test in Croatia</p></span></div></figcaption></figure><p>De la Fuente and his staff now finalize preparations for their next Nations League test away against Croatia on October 6. The manager intends to continue balancing squad freshness with winning results.</p><p>Czechia remain bottom of Group 3 without a point.</p><p>Spain look to secure another three points in their pursuit of the knockout
